cut: Global 3 draft v1 (30 Oct): VIRAL cut from its first version. A graphics card on a store shelf, $570 in June, $805 in August; memory carted off from the DRAM works to an AI data centre; a lawsuit alleges the shortage was planned (stamped ALLEGED); the makers ask the court to dismiss it, hearing 13 Nov; back on the shelf, the receipt prints $805; the clipping turns back to June: loop.
argument: A graphics card rose from $570 to $805 in two months as memory makers moved to AI chips; a lawsuit alleges the shortage was planned, and the makers ask the court to dismiss it.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: A graphics card: / $570 in June, / [$805] in August.
text.ja: グラフィックボード / 6月は 570ドル、 / 8月は [805ドル]。

captions.source: Tom's Hardware's Newegg tracking, Aug 2026, as reported by TweakTown, PCGamesN, Digital Citizen and VGTimes (the Tom's Hardware original not opened): the US Newegg median price of the RTX 5060 Ti 16GB rose from $569.99 in June 2026 to $804.99 in August 2026; NVIDIA's list prices did not change; Tom's Hardware attributed the rise to memory demand outstripping supply, driven by AI. Rounded to $570 and $805 on screen. The card is named on the clipping.

text.en: Memory makers / moved production / to [AI] chips.
text.ja: メモリ各社は / 生産を [AI]向けへ。

captions.source: Samsung, SK hynix and Micron have shifted DRAM capacity to high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI accelerators, which earns higher margins (trade reporting through 2026: Network World on Samsung's warning; TrendForce; Tom's Hardware's attribution of the GPU price rise). The class action itself describes the shift to HBM (and calls it a pretext; that is the allegation in caption 3, not this one).

text.en: A lawsuit alleges / the shortage / was [planned].
text.ja: 訴訟は 品不足が / [計画的]だったと 主張。

captions.source: Garciaguirre et al. v. Samsung Electronics Co. et al., No. 3:26-cv-06345 (or 5:26-cv-06345), N.D. Cal., filed 25 June 2026 (CourtListener and PacerMonitor dockets; Tom's Hardware, TrendForce, PC Gamer, Quartz): 17 individuals and small businesses ALLEGE that Samsung, SK hynix and Micron coordinated to restrict conventional DRAM supply and that the HBM shift was a pretext, citing a roughly 700% rise over four years. Allegations only, unproven. 'Planned' is the plain word for the complaint's 'coordinated restriction of supply'.

text.en: The makers / ask the court / to [dismiss] it.
text.ja: メーカー側は / 訴えの [却下]を 求める。

captions.source: The CourtListener docket for 3:26-cv-06345 (search summary, not opened): Micron, SK hynix and the Samsung entities filed a motion to dismiss; plaintiffs opposed; defendants replied on 7 Oct; the hearing was reset to 13 Nov 2026, 9:00, San Jose, before Judge Noël Wise. Micron, in a statement to Moneywise: it competes vigorously, fairly and in compliance with all applicable laws, and will defend itself against the claims (paraphrase, not quoted). Samsung and SK hynix: no public comment found; SK hynix disclosed the suit in its amended F-1.

text.ja: 意図的でも なくても / 払うのは [805ドル]。

captions.source: The station's line. 'Planned or not' keeps the allegation open: the court has not ruled. '$805' is the August median from caption 1.

post.en: A graphics card went from $570 to $805 in two months (US median, RTX 5060 Ti 16GB). Memory makers moved production to AI chips. A lawsuit alleges the shortage was planned; the makers ask the court to dismiss it. Hearing: 13 Nov. What did your last upgrade cost?
post.fi: Näytönohjain nousi kahdessa kuukaudessa 570 dollarista 805 dollariin (USA:n mediaani, RTX 5060 Ti 16GB). Muistitehtaat siirtyivät tekoälysiruihin. Kanne väittää pulan olleen suunniteltu; valmistajat pyytävät hylkäämään sen. Käsittely 13.11. Paljonko viimeisin päivityksesi maksoi?
post.ja: グラフィックボードが2か月で570ドルから805ドルに（米国中央値、RTX 5060 Ti 16GB）。メモリ各社は生産をAI向けへ。訴訟は品不足が計画的だったと主張し、メーカー側は却下を求めている。審理は11月13日。最後のアップグレード、いくらだった？
